name: Libertà
source:
Bears a contract with #0 of the Arcana - The Fool, also the soldier of the Intelligence Division. He calls her "Ojou". He loves masked heroes and admired Dante very much. A boy who is always curious and loves new things. He believes himself to be a Man of the Sea, and he’s even more impulsive than Felicitá. [spoiler]His memories got sealed by Dante because of his Arcana power went uncontrollable and he was also the reason why Dante went bald.[/spoiler] His Arcana Mark is on his forehead with the power to make whatever he says happen. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_storia_della_Arcana_Famiglia#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
